clue.text: Scour the brushwood

definitions.meaning: to scour is to clean by hard rubbing
low stunted trees and bushes covering rough ground

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses fit one word: a verb for vigorous cleaning and a noun for rough undergrowth.

clue.text: Under the surface, Maine is urban in a surprising way

indicators.note: letters arranged in a surprising way are rearranged

parts.note: ME is the postal abbreviation for the US state of Maine
taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Underground, the state of Maine turns out to be surprisingly city-like.
explanation.definitionFit: Submarine as an adjective means existing or operating beneath the sea's surface.

clue.text: King, one regretting touring Loch

indicators.note: touring means going round, so the regretting word surrounds the loch letter

parts.note: a ruer is one who rues, that is regrets
L is a map abbreviation for loch

explanation.surface: A monarch, full of regret, travels around a Scottish lake.
explanation.definitionFit: A king is a ruler, a sovereign who governs a realm.

clue.text: Outlaw in court with booty all over the place

indicators.note: all over the place means in disorder, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A criminal in a courtroom has his loot scattered everywhere.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Outlaw' looks like a noun for a bandit, but it is the verb meaning to ban.
explanation.definitionFit: To boycott something is to ban or shun it, a way of outlawing it socially.

clue.text: Bribe member in position of umpire, specifically

parts.note: to square someone is to buy them off with a bribe
a leg is a limb, one of the body's members

explanation.surface: An official is bribed while standing in a particular spot on the field.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket, square leg is the fielding position level with the batter on the leg side, where the second umpire stands.
explanation.definitionFit: Square leg is the cricket fielding position where the umpire at the striker's end stands.

clue.text: Boyfriend is persistent

definitions.meaning: a regular partner in dating slang, as in going with someone

explanation.surface: A girl says her boyfriend keeps pestering her.
explanation.definitionFit: One word means a regular dating partner and also firm, constant and unwavering.

clue.text: Unsuitable — not properly tailored?

definitions.meaning: of clothing, not cut to fit the wearer

explanation.surface: Clothes that do not fit are deemed unsuitable.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means unfit for a role and, read literally, describes clothes not fitted to the body.

clue.text: Disparage brief review.

definitions.meaning: a summary or quick account of the main points

explanation.surface: A critic pans a short summary.
explanation.definitionFit: As a phrasal verb it means to criticise; as a noun it means a quick summary.

clue.text: Rentals increasing, so relaxing one's efforts

parts.note: letting is the renting out of property
up means rising or going higher

explanation.surface: With rents going up, someone eases off at work.
explanation.definitionFit: Letting up is an idiom for easing off or slackening one's efforts.

clue.text: Prison system starts to give up on recidivist

indicators.note: starts to means the opening letters of the following words

parts.note: an old lag is a habitual offender, a lag for short

explanation.surface: A jail regime is the beginning of giving up on a repeat offender.
explanation.walkthrough: LAG is British slang for a convict, especially a repeat one.
explanation.definitionFit: The Gulag was the Soviet network of forced-labour camps, a whole penal system.

clue.text: Tinned meat caused Hector to complain

parts.note: to hector is to bully
to beef is slang for to grumble or complain

explanation.surface: Someone's canned meal made a man named Hector grumble.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hector' looks like a name but is the verb meaning to browbeat. Bully beef is British for tinned corned beef.
explanation.definitionFit: Bully beef is the traditional name for corned beef sold in tins, a soldier's ration.

clue.text: Like a birthday held by woman at a local

indicators.note: the letters are held within the run of words woman at a local

explanation.surface: A birthday party is hosted by a woman at her neighbourhood pub.
explanation.walkthrough: A local is British for one's nearby pub.
explanation.definitionFit: Natal means relating to birth, so a birthday is a natal anniversary.

clue.text: Publicity about health and regulation of atmosphere

indicators.note: about means going round, so the publicity word wraps the health word

parts.note: an airing is public exposure or discussion
condition means state of health, as in being in good condition

explanation.surface: A public campaign about health and atmospheric controls.
explanation.definitionFit: Air conditioning is the system that controls temperature and humidity of the air indoors.

clue.text: Solicit in court

definitions.meaning: to ask for or request something
to court danger is to bring it on oneself, to provoke or attract it

explanation.surface: A lawyer touts for business in a courtroom.
explanation.definitionFit: One verb means both to request formally and to bring on or encourage, as in courting trouble.

clue.text: Where you have to look for help

definitions.text: Where you have to look for help

parts.words: Where you have to look for help
parts.note: read literally, assistance that comes through the eyes, something you must look at

explanation.surface: Someone asks where to seek assistance.
explanation.definitionFit: A chart, slide or model shown to aid understanding is something you look at for help.

clue.text: Youngster seen about after twelve?

parts.note: a young person spotted out late at night, but really one whose age has passed twelve

explanation.surface: A child spotted out and about after midnight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'After twelve' suggests the hour; it means the age, thirteen to nineteen.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone aged thirteen to nineteen is a youngster whose years come after twelve.

clue.text: What makes the motorist street-wise?

parts.note: street-wise usually means savvy about city life; here it means wise about the street itself

explanation.surface: A question about what gives a driver savvy.
explanation.definitionFit: This phrase names a driver's instinctive awareness of traffic and hazards on the road.

clue.text: Individual that's guarded in speech

indicators.note: in speech means as spoken, so the word sounds like the guarded word

parts.note: discreet means careful and guarded in what one says

explanation.surface: Someone who is careful about what they say.
explanation.definitionFit: Discrete means separate and distinct, existing as individual units.

clue.text: European community still on cloud nine!

parts.note: static means motionless, still

explanation.surface: The European Community is still euphoric.
explanation.definitionFit: Being on cloud nine is an idiom for being overjoyed, in rapture.

clue.text: Competitor allowed to enter rearranged heat

indicators.note: to enter means to go inside, so the allowed word sits within the other letters
rearranged plainly signals that heat's letters are reordered

parts.note: let means permitted or allowed

explanation.surface: A competitor is permitted into a rescheduled qualifying race.
explanation.walkthrough: A heat here reads as a qualifying race, but it is only fodder: 'rearranged' gives ATHE, and 'to enter' sends LET into it.
explanation.definitionFit: An athlete is someone who competes in sports events.

clue.text: Bear rejected by the French as fair game

indicators.note: rejected means thrown back, so the bear's name is read backwards

parts.note: Pooh is the famous fictional bear
la is the French feminine word for the

explanation.surface: A bear is turned away by the French as a legitimate target.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fair game' looks like the idiom for a legitimate target; it means a game at a fair, where rings are thrown over prizes.
explanation.definitionFit: Hoopla is a fairground game in which players throw rings to land over prizes.

clue.text: Rather obscure question, going into comic opera

indicators.note: going into means entering, so the question letters sit inside the rest
comic suggests the word opera is played about with and rearranged

explanation.surface: A question that crops up in a comic opera is rather baffling.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rather obscure' is a comparative adjective, matching the -ER ending. 'comic' gives OPAER, and 'going into' sends QU into it.
explanation.definitionFit: Opaque means hard to understand, so a more opaque thing is rather more obscure.

clue.text: Went off to destroy Trojan leader

parts.note: to spoil is to ruin or destroy

indicators.note: leader means the first letter of the word Trojan

explanation.surface: Someone left to kill the commander of Troy.
explanation.definitionFit: Food that has spoilt has gone off, become rotten.

clue.text: Horsey chap involved with a club having head of a particular type

definitions.text: having head of a particular type

indicators.note: involved means tangled up, so these letters are mixed together

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A horse-loving man joins a club for people with a certain kind of head.
explanation.definitionFit: Brachycephalous is a technical term for having a short, broad skull.

clue.text: The infant left in the tower

parts.note: a babe is a baby or infant

explanation.surface: A baby is abandoned inside the tower.
explanation.definitionFit: The Tower of Babel is the biblical tower whose builders were scattered by confused languages.

clue.text: Nothing decent left out, in the main

parts.note: O looks like zero, nothing

indicators.note: out means taken away, so the left letter is removed from the decent word

parts.note: clean means decent, free of anything rude

explanation.surface: Nothing respectable is left out at sea.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The main' is an old poetic name for the open sea.
explanation.definitionFit: The main is a literary term for the high seas, the open sea.

clue.text: Defy Indian warrior

definitions.meaning: to face up to danger or opposition
an old term for a Native American fighting man

explanation.surface: A fighter stands up to his foes.
explanation.definitionFit: One word is a verb for facing danger boldly and an old noun for a Native American fighter.

clue.text: Gourmet, seeing a prune ice, going bananas!

indicators.note: going bananas means going crazy, so these letters are scrambled

explanation.surface: A food lover goes wild at the sight of a prune-flavoured ice cream.
explanation.definitionFit: An epicurean is a person devoted to refined food and drink, a gourmet.

clue.text: Accommodate troops, given time — and a deposit!

parts.note: to lodge someone is to house them
men is a common word for soldiers

explanation.surface: Housing soldiers comes with a time limit and a security deposit.
explanation.definitionFit: A lodgement is something lodged, such as money paid in or material deposited.

clue.text: Ramble within bounds

definitions.meaning: the limits within which something varies

explanation.surface: A walker wanders but stays inside the boundary.
explanation.definitionFit: One word means to roam widely and also the scope or limits of something.
